datasets.title: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model, surface elevation tile
datasets.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
datasets.role: Real Earth DEM sample used to verify public download, raster metadata, and elevation units. This single tile is not a global coverage claim.
datasets.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022. ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74
limitations: The sample is one 15 by 15 degree tile named S15W075; it includes land and bathymetry.
The project-wide analysis grid and effective physical scale remain subject to the K-002 G1 benchmark.
Use an independent land mask; do not infer land by thresholding elevation at zero.
NOAA states the product is not for navigation.

datasets.title: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter LOLA Gridded Digital Elevation Model, LDEM_4
datasets.provider: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node / LOLA Data Node
datasets.role: Real lunar altimetry-derived gridded shape sample for checking the planetary data ingestion and label interpretation.

license.citation_guidance: Cite the PDS data set DOI and product; PDS archive documents may have separate copyright statements.

datasets.format: PDS image array with detached PDS3 LBL and PDS4 XML labels

sample_grid.coverage: global; 0-360 degrees east longitude and 90 degrees north to 90 degrees south
sample_grid.coordinate_system: body-fixed rotating; mean Earth/polar axis of DE421
sample_grid.nodata: No missing-data constant is declared in the sampled product label.
sample_grid.interpretation: Planetary radius = DN * 0.5 m + 1,737,400 m. True topography relative to the lunar geoid requires planetary radius minus geoid radius; this sample is a radius/shape map relative to a reference sphere, not a directly comparable absolute elevation datum.

limitations: The 4 pixels per degree sample has a coarser scale than the final detail needed for all lunar analog features.
Lunar reference radii and geoid are not Earth or Mars vertical datums.
A missing-data constant is not declared; do not invent one.

datasets.title: Mars Global Surveyor MOLA MEGDR, global 4 pixels per degree topography and counts
datasets.provider: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
datasets.role: Real Mars altimetry-derived topography sample; the paired count map records direct observations and must be retained for quality handling.

license.citation_guidance: Cite the PDS4 bundle DOI and product; PDS archive documents may have separate copyright statements.

datasets.format: PDS3 image arrays with detached PDS3 LBL and maintained PDS4 XML labels

sample_grid.coverage: global; 0-360 degrees east longitude and 90 degrees north to 90 degrees south
sample_grid.vertical_reference: planetary radius minus the MOLA areoid (GMM-3)
sample_grid.nodata_policy: The topography product fills unobserved bins by interpolation. Retain the counts map; a count of zero means no direct observations in that bin and must be exposed as an observation-quality limitation.

limitations: The 4 pixels per degree grid is about 14.8 km per pixel at the equator; angular cell size does not represent a constant physical distance over latitude.
The PDS4 label dated 2026-09-15 is the maintained label and corrects the map pixel scale/geotransform metadata; preserve it with the data.
Interpolated bins are not direct measurements. Exclude or separately flag zero-count cells when the comparison requires observed values.

blocked_or_planned_sources.role: NASA Earth DEM sample for an independent Earth-elevation comparison; NASADEM also provides a land/water byte mask in its related SWB file.
blocked_or_planned_sources.citation: NASA JPL. NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001. 2020. NASA EOSDIS Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/MEaSUREs/NASADEM/NASADEM_HGT.001
blocked_or_planned_sources.access_method: NASA Earthdata Login credentials via earthaccess or authenticated HTTPS; never put credentials or tokens in the repository.
blocked_or_planned_sources.observed_access: CMR metadata lookup succeeded without authentication; the granule is catalogued. An unauthenticated data request returned the Earthdata login page, so no NASADEM measurements were downloaded or verified in this run.

guide_metadata.hgt_no_data: The user guide lists no fill or no-data value.
guide_metadata.coverage: NASADEM/SRTM latitude coverage does not include polar regions.

blocked_or_planned_sources.role: Candidate independent land and lake polygon mask; do not derive land from a zero-elevation threshold.
blocked_or_planned_sources.license: GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL), according to NOAA NCEI.
blocked_or_planned_sources.coverage_and_format: Global hierarchical closed polygons; WGS84 geographic coordinates; multiple resolutions and shoreline/lake hierarchy levels.
